query: INSERT INTO title_generator_knowledge (title, keywords, relative_perf, engagement_rate, history_weight, normalized_score, streamer_size, source_streamer) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8) ON CONFLICT (title, game_context) DO UPDATE SET normalized_score = GREATEST(title_generator_knowledge.normalized_score, EXCLUDED.normalized_score), quality_tier = CASE WHEN EXCLUDED.normalized_score > 2.0 THEN 3 WHEN EXCLUDED.normalized_score > 1.5 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END
